name: thetis
description: Thetis: larvae photo analysis and tank risk rules for shellfish hatcheries (localhost MVP)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed --reset
scripts.seed:full: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed --reset --full
scripts.slides: uv run --project backend python tools/gen_slides.py fixtures/slides
